description: no name: the new survey's record
difference: The old API's create left CreatorId all zeros and IsPublished null until the survey was published or unpublished; the bridge answers the real creator and Studio's published flag (never null), as docs/api/legacy-compat.md lists. The old CreatedAt was the server's local time; the bridge's is UTC. The old record's Name was null (no name stored); Studio names it "New Survey N".
